user.title: SwitchBot credentials
user.description: Open the SwitchBot app: Profile → Preferences → Developer Options to get your token and secret.

select_remotes.title: Select "Others" remotes
select_remotes.description: These are the learned ("Others"-type) IR remotes found on your account. Pick the ones you want in Home Assistant.

buttons.title: Buttons for {remote_name}
buttons.description: Enter the button names exactly as you set them in the SwitchBot app, one per line. Capitalization and spacing must match (e.g. "TEMP UP", not "temp up").

reauth_confirm.title: Reauthenticate SwitchBot
reauth_confirm.description: Your SwitchBot token or secret was rejected. Paste fresh credentials from the SwitchBot app (Profile → Preferences → Developer Options).

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the SwitchBot API.

abort.no_others_remotes: No "Others"-type remotes were found on this SwitchBot account.
abort.already_configured: This SwitchBot account is already configured.
abort.account_mismatch: These credentials belong to a different SwitchBot account than the one being reauthenticated.

select_remotes.title: Select "Others" remotes
select_remotes.description: Pick the "Others"-type remotes you want in Home Assistant. Newly-added remotes will appear here.

buttons.title: Buttons for {remote_name}
buttons.description: Update the button names for this remote. One per line, exactly as named in the SwitchBot app.
